'''Bryophyta''' ({{IPAc-en|,|b|r|aɪ|oʊ|'|f|aɪ|t|ə}}, {{respell|BRY|oh|FY|tə}}), the Moss Giantess, is a [[moss giant]] [[boss]] who can be found in her lair in the [[Varrock Sewers]]. The entrance to the lair is located just east of the moss giants in the sewers, and can be accessed by navigating the sewers, using the level 51 [[Obstacle pipe (Edgeville Dungeon)|Agility shortcut]] from [[Edgeville Dungeon]], or by teleporting with a [[giantsoul amulet]].

A [[mossy key]] is needed to unlock the [[Gate (Bryophyta)|gate]] leading to Bryophyta's lair for the first time, but subsequent access to the lair does not require a key. The key will not be consumed when unlocking Bryophyta's lair.

The keys also open the [[Chest (Bryophyta's Lair)|chest]] found in her lair. Each opening uses one mossy key and requires one Bryophyta kill, similar to [[Obor]] and [[giant key]]s. Bryophyta respawns 15 ticks (9 seconds) after attempting to open her chest, or on leaving and re-entering the instance, regardless of whether the player has a mossy key in their inventory.

The chest is the sole source of [[Bryophyta's essence]], which is used to make [[Bryophyta's staff]]. This item can store [[nature rune]]s, and has a chance to not consume them when casting a spell that uses them.

==Strategy==
To access Bryophyta's lair, players will need a [[knife]] or a [[Slash weapons|slash weapon]] to cut through the web if approaching via the [[Varrock Sewers]]. Members with level 51 [[Agility]] can bypass this by using the agility [[shortcut]] near [[Vannaka]] in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. Alternatively, a charged [[Giantsoul amulet]] can teleport players directly outside the entrance to her lair.

Unlike Obor’s chambers, where he is confined in a small pit, players are taken directly to Bryophyta’s chambers, where she attacks on sight. It is recommended to activate [[Protect from Magic]] before entering, or immediately upon entry, before opening the [[Gate (Bryophyta)|gate]].

[[File:Fighting Bryophyta.png|thumb|left|250px|A player fighting Bryophyta.]]

In members' worlds, Bryophyta can [[poison]] players, starting at 8 damage; it is advisable to bring poison protection even when using [[protection prayers]].

Throughout the fight, there is a 1/5 chance that Bryophyta may summon three [[growthling]]s that '''must be killed with either an [[axe]] or [[magic secateurs]]'''. Bryophyta is immune to all damage (except poison and venom) while they are alive. Although the [[blessed axe]] is a woodcutting axe, it will not work. If no item with the "[[Axe]]" attack type is brought, players can take a [[bronze axe]] from the [[logs (Bryophyta)|pile of logs]] in the lair; other types of axes, such as [[battleaxe]]s or the [[zombie axe]], '''cannot''' be used to kill the growthlings. Bryophyta can only summon one batch of growthlings at a time, and there a cooldown of around 20 ticks between summons.

[[Free-to-play]] players should wear [[green d'hide armour]] for magic defence, along with a [[rune kiteshield]] and [[rune full helm]] for optimal protection against her attacks. God armours like [[Guthix armour]] offer a slight advantage with a +1 Prayer bonus per piece and are only marginally more expensive than rune armour. Offensively, a [[rune scimitar]] is recommended for its strength bonus. Players should have at least 50 strength, attack, and defence before attempting to fight Bryophyta.

Ranging Bryophyta is the best strategy for mid-level F2P players, with recommended stats of 60 Ranged, 40 Defence, and 37 Prayer. The ideal setup includes [[green d'hide armour]], a [[coif]], an [[amulet of power]], and a [[maple shortbow]] with [[adamant arrows]]. Maintaining a safe distance is crucial, as she won’t move towards players and won’t use melee attacks if they are out of her reach. Using [[Protect from Magic]] will further minimise damage. 

Bryophyta's 50% fire weakness makes magic highly viable in F2P. With at least 37 Prayer and 59 Magic, using Protect from Magic and Fire Blast offers the highest DPS for F2P players by a wide margin. As with the ranged strategy, keeping your distance is crucial. Best-in-slot magic gear with the Fire Staff is the recommended equipment. 

[[Members]] players can kill her very quickly by utilizing powerful [[Special attacks|special attack]] weapons, such as [[Dragon claws|Dragon Claws]] or a [[Voidwaker]]. With access to the [[Desert amulet 4]] or a [[Restoration pool]] built in their [[player-owned house]] to restore special attack energy between kills, as well as a Giantsoul amulet to return back to her lair quickly, players can expect anywhere from 6-8 mossy keys per hour depending on efficiency.

* The [[mossy key]] drop rate has increased from 1/32 to 1/16.
* The cooldown that restricts the spawn of [[growthling]]s should now be more consistent.
* You can now one-shot growthlings if you have an [[axe]] or [[magic secateurs]] equipped.

{{Subject changes
|date = 25 June 2025
|update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat
|change = 
* Bryophyta no longer requires a [[mossy key]] to be fought. However, the first encounter with her will still require the key as a means to permanently unlock access to the boss.
* Bryophyta's drop table has been replaced with a simpler loot table similar to [[moss giant]]s, with an increased chance at a [[mossy key]], as well as a chance of [[giant bones]] for members.
* Bryophyta's original loot table has been moved to [[Chest (Bryophyta's Lair)|a chest]] within her lair, which is opened using a [[mossy key]] and can only be opened when she is defeated.
* [[Growthling]]s can now be finished off with one-click when equipping an axe, instead of needing to use the axe on it to do so.
* The cooldown that restricts the spawn of [[growthlings]] has been tweaked.
}}

==Trivia==
*{{Wp|Bryophyta}} is the scientific name for mosses.
*The update which introduced Bryophyta also made [[Antipoison]] potions available to free-to-play players and able to be purchased from [[Apothecary's Potions]] in Varrock.
**The idea of Bryophyta poisoning in free-to-play was scrapped prior to release; however, [[Antipoison]] potions still remain free-to-play.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1231689392995078146|date=23 February 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96770|archivedate=28 February 2020|quote=Not sure. The development of that particular boss was difficult, due to the dev being very inexperienced at the time, with Maz having to step in very late on to take over. The original dev may have enabled them on F2P for a reason that was later scrapped.}}
*It is possible to have growthlings summoned at the same time Bryophyta gets last damage (even without poison or venom) and fight them after her death.
*As the axe is being used as a weapon and not as a tool, the player can still kill growthlings with an axe with a higher [[Woodcutting]] requirement than the player has.
